class.name: JustAMCPAssetTagsTools
class.brief_description: Provides MCP tools for project asset tag dictionary and assignment.
class.description: Registers asset tag tool schemas used by [JustAMCPToolExecutor] and [JustAMCPToolsetRegistry]. Tools expose tag dictionary CRUD, asset assignment, search, and maintenance helpers for AI-driven asset organization.

method.name: execute_tool
method.description: Executes the asset-tag tool named by [param tool_name] with [param arguments] and returns the tool response dictionary. Unknown tools return an error dictionary.

method.name: provide_tool_schemas
method.description: Returns MCP JSON schema dictionaries for asset-tag tools. Set [param register_only] for registration metadata only, or [param ignore_settings] to bypass editor filtering.
